name: Meme Search
description_en: AI-powered meme search engine. Automatically extracts descriptions from images using vision-language models, then indexes with vector embeddings for semantic and keyword search. `Apache-2.0` `Docker`
description: The open source Meme Search Engine and Finder.  Free and built to self-host locally with Python, Ruby, and Docker.
readme_preview: Use AI to index your memes by their content and text, making them easily retrievable for your meme warfare pleasures. By default, processing from image-to-text extraction, to vector embedding, to search is performed locally. You can also use an OpenAI-compatible vision API for description generation while keeping embeddings and search local.
